items.note: ok the KITCHEN. double-height barrel-vaulted ceiling, a fireplace next to the breakfast table, AND a wine cellar with a tasting room downstairs. 2.3 acres. i can't.
a 1928 bronxville house with a stone wall and a whole perennial garden out front. it's giving storybook!!
bronxville!! five bedrooms, would look SO good with a wreath on the door.
5.5 bathrooms for 5 bedrooms. nobody in this house is ever waiting for a shower.

items.title: the Babydoll line dance
items.body: solo, with the family, or with a whole crew doing the babydoll line dance. it's one of the few trends still rising this week. very wedding-dance energy.

items.title: the "almost almost" meme
items.creator: Jynxzi (sound)
items.body: a photo of you JUST missing something, like a dunk or a climb, set to a sound about almost making it. so relatable it hurts.

items.title: the shoulder carry flip
items.body: one person rides on the other's shoulders, then they flip on the beat. people call it the "I'm the one" trend. looks terrifying, still very cute.

items.title: the Grinch pet filter
items.body: a filter that turns your pet into the grinch, green fur and a santa suit included. my feed is all grinch dogs rn.

items.title: gen z is feeling GOOD about money
items.body: a TransUnion survey out yesterday: 68% of gen z feel optimistic about their finances for the next year, up from 63%. the overall average is 55%.

items.title: and they're spending on the holidays
items.body: 71% of gen z plan to spend the same or more than last year on holiday shopping, vs 58% overall. 34% plan to spend over $500.

items.title: the "gen z stare"
items.body: the blank look some gen z give when you'd expect them to answer, like at a register. people argue whether it's anxiety, boredom or just deadpan humor.
